items.html: And then the offspring emerges, including male and female: the male from MaH of BaN, and the female from BaN of BaN; and both of them are Gevurot from BaN. And this is the root of Cain, for he emerges from the name BaN, whose beginning is the name SaG, greater than the name MaH. And Seth came out, his male and his female, from the Hesed and Gevura of Aba, which are MaH of MaH and BaN of MaH. But Abel came out in halves: half from MaH of MaH, and half from MaH of BaN; and his female half from BaN of MaH and half from BaN of BaN. They divided into two twins; and that one which was of BaN of BaN was called the extra twin, since she is from the aspect of Cain; therefore Cain was jealous of her. Understand this.
